title: Warranty Plan Issued and Open Repair Order Limit by Class — Insurance Claim Repairs
content:
Two further per-class terms of Insurance Claim Repairs: the workmanship warranty issued when the vehicle is delivered, and the number of repair orders one insurer claim number may have open on one vehicle at once.

| Repair class | Workmanship warranty issued on delivery | Open repair orders per insurer claim number on one vehicle |
|---|---|---|
| Express Claim Repair | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | 1 |
| Standard Claim Repair | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | 1 |
| Major Claim Repair | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | 1 |
| Structural Claim Repair | Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty | 1 |
| Certified Structural Claim Repair | Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty | 1 |
| Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair | Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty | 1 |

### Questions this table answers

**Which warranty does a delivered Major Claim Repair vehicle receive?** The Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty, the plan named for that class.

**Which warranty does a delivered Certified Structural Claim Repair vehicle receive?** The Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty; all three structural classes issue that plan.

**How many repair orders may one claim number have open on one vehicle?** One, in every class.
